title: Baddeck, and That Sort of Thing
sourceTitle: Baddeck, and That Sort of Thing
author: Charles Dudley Warner
description: "Baddeck, and That Sort of Thing" by Charles Dudley Warner is a travel narrative written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book recounts the adventures of two comrades embarking on a journey to explore the provinces of Canada, particularly focusing on their experiences in Baddeck, a region that piques their interest for its natural beauty and opportunities for fishing.
